page_title: PAU 0-0 EIN | St. Pauli v Eintracht Frankfurt 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90+7' A cross into the box from Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
90+6' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) tries to find Arkadiusz Pyrka, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
90+3' Referee Felix Zwayer halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Alexander Blessin, then shows him a yellow.

90+2' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
90+1' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
90+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
87' Substitution. Fares Chaibi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Love Arrhov (Eintracht Frankfurt).
86' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

86' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Eintracht Frankfurt.
85' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle as Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

84' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right post, but Nikola Vasilj pulls off a fine save to deny him.
83' Albert Riera decides to make a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo will be replaced by Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt).
82' The resulting corner from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is cleared.
81' It is time for a substitution. Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) is on for James Sands.
80' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

80' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli win a corner kick.

80' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted! St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Felix Zwayer blows for a foul after Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. St. Pauli are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
76' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
74' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

74' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
72' The attendance is 29546.

67' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer made an astonishing save!
66' Here is a change. Tomoya Ando is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
66' Oscar Hojlund goes off the pitch and Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
65' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a big opportunity. He shoots from the free kick just outside the box, but his poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
64' Rough tackle by Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.
62' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) has tested the patience of referee Felix Zwayer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
52' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
48' Alexander Blessin is forced to make a change. Manolis Saliakas is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli).
47' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

46' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Nikola Vasilj pulls off a brilliant save.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
44' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
41' The ref blows his whistle to halt play for an injury that he’s actually picked up!
36' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

34' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.

31' OFF THE POST! Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
29' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
27' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
27' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.

25' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
23' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) hits the left post with a rebound from near the penalty spot.
23' The corner is swung in but St. Pauli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
17' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

15' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
7' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) commits a foul and Felix Zwayer immediately signals a free kick.
4' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
4' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick.
2' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
